documents.title: Declaration of Beneficial Ownership — Highmark Trading Ltd
documents.text:
Declaration
This declaration is made on behalf of Highmark Trading Ltd, a company registered in BLZ, in connection with the opening and continued maintenance of banking facilities. It is given on 2026-01-17 and supersedes any previous declaration of beneficial ownership held by the institution.

Beneficial owner
The undersigned confirms that Eleanor Margaret Wycliffe is the ultimate beneficial owner of Highmark Trading Ltd, holding an effective interest of 4.32 per cent. of the issued share capital, whether directly or through one or more intermediate holding entities.

Threshold statement
The applicable reporting threshold in BLZ is 25 per cent. The interest declared above does not exceed that threshold and is accordingly not reportable under the applicable regulations.

Undertaking
The undersigned undertakes to notify the institution in writing within thirty days of any change to the information set out above, including any change in the identity of the ultimate beneficial owner or in the percentage interest held.

Declaration
This declaration is made on behalf of Harbourline Trading Ltd, a company registered in CYM, in connection with the opening and continued maintenance of banking facilities. It is given on 2024-12-30 and supersedes any previous declaration of beneficial ownership held by the institution.

passages.heading: Beneficial owner
passages.text:
Beneficial owner
The undersigned confirms that Sergey Melnyk is the ultimate beneficial owner of Harbourline Trading Ltd, holding an effective interest of 26.17 per cent. of the issued share capital, whether directly or through one or more intermediate holding entities.

passages.heading: Threshold statement
passages.text:
Threshold statement
The applicable reporting threshold in CYM is 25 per cent. The interest declared above exceeds that threshold and is therefore reportable under the applicable regulations.

passages.heading: Undertaking
passages.text:
Undertaking
The undersigned undertakes to notify the institution in writing within thirty days of any change to the information set out above, including any change in the identity of the ultimate beneficial owner or in the percentage interest held.

passages.heading: Source of wealth
passages.text:
Source of wealth
The funds introduced to Quarry Group FZE derive from the disposal of operating businesses and from accumulated investment income over a period exceeding ten years. No part of the funds derives from a jurisdiction subject to comprehensive sanctions.

passages.heading: Supporting evidence
passages.text:
Supporting evidence
Supporting documentation comprising audited financial statements and completion statements has been provided to the institution and is held on file.

passages.text:
Resolution
RESOLVED that Silverbirch Management Ltd open and maintain banking facilities and that the authorised signatories named in the schedule be empowered to operate those facilities on behalf of the company.

passages.heading: Certification

Certification
The foregoing resolution was duly passed at a meeting of the board of directors of Silverbirch Management Ltd held on 2024-11-29 and has not been rescinded or amended.
